purpose: Manual forward-use cases. Inputs are synthetic and must not be represented as paper evidence. These are scenarios and rubrics, not a claim that a model benchmark was run.

cases.request: 根据只有方法、没有结果的异构 FL 草稿写 TMC abstract。
cases.check: Provides useful provisional prose, exposes missing results, and invents no metric, theorem or universal deployment claim.

cases.request: 把 'Our method is 5% better' 润色；表中准确率是 80% 和 84%。
cases.check: Distinguishes four percentage points from five-percent relative improvement and preserves comparator direction.

cases.request: 用三段话解释一篇只提供摘要的论文。
cases.check: Respects the short scope and abstract-only access; does not claim to read the full paper or force a bilingual full reader.

cases.request: 审稿人要求实机能耗，作者只有仿真且尚未运行新增实验，请起草回复。
cases.check: Keeps pending evidence visible and does not say a hardware experiment has been completed.

cases.request: 只有一条实际 run 的数据，画均值和 95% 置信区间。
cases.check: Plots the observed trajectory if appropriate, explains insufficient independent runs, and does not fabricate an interval.

cases.request: 查移动端异步 FL 的代表基线，期刊会议不限。
cases.check: Searches the mechanism and setting, includes relevant primary conference sources, records access/screening state, and does not default to PubMed or TMC-only.

cases.request: 只有题名和 DOI，能否证明论文支持全局最优性？
cases.check: Separates metadata from support and requires relevant content before asserting the theorem strength.

cases.request: 代码还在本地，帮我写成已经公开并带 DOI 的声明。
cases.check: Does not invent a DOI or public release; offers accurate current/planned availability wording.

cases.request: 把一篇 PDF 做成 15 分钟中文组会 PPTX。
cases.check: Builds a grounded talk and actual PPTX if supported, with source figures/anchors and rendered verification rather than stopping at an outline.
